output.reason: New bladder control difficulty and numbness between the legs one week after a lifting back injury raises possible cauda equina syndrome, a time-critical surgical emergency requiring immediate emergency assessment with imaging.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. New trouble controlling your bladder plus numbness between your legs after a back injury can mean nerve compression in your lower spine, which needs urgent imaging and specialist assessment today. Do not wait for a message reply. Have someone drive you, or call 911 if you develop leg weakness, cannot walk, or cannot urinate at all.
